candidateSource: Stage 6 working tree; left uncommitted for review
executionNotes: Executed the complete suite as separate shell and artwork groups against the pinned archive.

The shell group tested an earlier build attestation of the same runtime. Its RootFS diff IDs, Config, architecture, OS and creation timestamp are identical to the final image; the final artwork group and final image scan use the recorded candidate ID.

The first artwork candidate group passed 33 cases; Smashing Mega Scene timed out waiting for locator screenshot stability. Replacing diagnostic capture with a viewport rectangle and allowing heavy artwork 90 seconds resolved it; the remaining group plus that rerun passed all 44 cases.

Original-image observations include 77 sketches. Treee needed a focused longer-budget screenshot rerun; a visitor setup hook was scoped to the app origin and Generative Boids was rerecorded to remove a harness-created third-party-frame error.
